constraints: sendPrivKey and recipPubKey should be generated by the GENERATE ENCRYPTION KEYPAIR command (Secured Protocol theme); the keys use a cross-platform PKCS format.
Uses the TLS protocol algorithm/features; the TLS protocol components must be installed on the machine even if TLS is not otherwise used for server connections.

Data encrypted with only the sender's private key can be decrypted by anyone holding the matching public key; passing both sendPrivKey and recipPubKey restricts decryption to the single holder of the recipient's private key.
Encrypted data produced here can only be decrypted with the DECRYPT BLOB command.

overloadMerges.note: The draft marked 'toEncrypt' as direction 'in', but the parameter table lists it with col2 '↔' (a second unnamed row describes the same slot as returning 'Encrypted data'): the BLOB is overwritten in place with the encrypted result.

params.name: toEncrypt
params.description: in: data to encrypt; out: the encrypted data (overwrites the input BLOB)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Encrypts a BLOB's content in place using the sender's private key (and optionally the recipient's public key), overwriting it with the encrypted data.
